name: Aim Charm body
notes: How the Aim Charm looks on the ground (a red and white target) and the box the player touches to pick it up. Its shadow sits on the origin. Not solid and only touches the player: monsters walk over it and never take it. Shared by the classic run's floor item (item_aim_charm) the waves mode's drop (item_waves_aim_charm) and its picture on the items screen after a win (prop_prize_aim_charm).
